[[Hydra (Ascalon)|Hydras]] are large three-headed lizards that use potent [[Fire Magic]]. The Hydras in Ascalon are found in small groups of two to four, throughout the northwest territories of [[Post-Searing]] Ascalon. These groups tend to mingle with other indigenous enemies in these areas; for example, with [[Stone Fury|Stone Furies]] and [[Boulder Elemental]]s in the Ascalon Foothills, and [[Charr]] hunting bands in the Flame Temple Corridor. In the northern region of Dragon's Gullet, Hydra groups flock together in herds, forming lethal mobs when attacked.

== Notes ==
* Hydras tend to initiate combat with [[Area of Effect]] Fire Spells when players enter their [[aggro]] range. These spells can cause especially high damage to a party's [[henchmen]] or [[hero|heroes]], who tend to cluster around the lead player. Parties made up of grouped players may wish to spread apart to avoid presenting densely clumped targets to the beasts.

* Hydras may also sprint through gaps in the battle line to attack rear-rank characters with both [[PBAoE]] spells and melee attacks.

* Where possible, it is best to separate Hydras from the other groups in the area, and fight them under more controlled conditions.

* Their auto attacks deal piercing damage.
